summary: DSS, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement with related-party lender, Alset, Inc., for a $1,000,000 loan. Alset, under common control with DSS's chairman, will receive a convertible promissory note (3% simple interest, 5-year maturity, convertible at $0.45/share) and warrants to purchase 17,777,776 shares at $0.50/share (3-year term). The transaction is subject to stockholder approval and is a related-party private financing, increasing potential dilution. Watch for shareholder vote and near-term conversion pressure, given the low conversion price relative to market.
